clue.text: Its majority shareholder gets a desirable opportunity

definitions.text: Its majority shareholder gets a desirable opportunity

parts.words: Its majority shareholder gets a desirable opportunity
parts.note: a forked chicken bone is pulled by two people, and whoever keeps the bigger share is granted a wish

explanation.surface: A business report: the person holding most of the shares lands an attractive chance.
explanation.walkthrough: The boardroom language misleads: the 'shares' are pieces of a snapped bird's bone, and the 'opportunity' is the wish the winner gets to make.
explanation.definitionFit: The forked breastbone of a fowl is pulled apart, and the holder of the larger piece makes a wish.

clue.text: Sadly reflecting on university learner's swift breakdown

indicators.note: a breakdown is a collapse, so the letters fall apart and are rearranged

parts.note: L is the learner plate abbreviation
taken as written

explanation.surface: A student mourns a quick collapse at college.
explanation.definitionFit: Being pensively yearning is thinking back with melancholy longing.

clue.text: She acts as a maid, often

definitions.text: She acts as a maid, often

parts.words: She acts as a maid, often
parts.note: an actress who plays a pert servant, a stock role in comedy and opera

explanation.definitionFit: This stock theatrical role is a flirtatious lady's servant played by a soprano or actress.

clue.text: Where people queue for drinks between pieces of music?

definitions.meaning: a queue at a pub counter
the vertical stroke on a stave divides one measure from the next

explanation.walkthrough: The second sense takes 'pieces' as the measures of a score, not whole works.
explanation.definitionFit: A queue at the pub counter, and the vertical line on a score separating measures.

clue.text: Fix wedding for 17th of March, say

definitions.meaning: to set the date of one's marriage, an idiom
St Patrick's Day, the feast of the saint whose name a Patrick bears

explanation.walkthrough: In some countries people celebrate the feast of the saint they are named after; 17 March is St Patrick's.
explanation.definitionFit: Setting the wedding date is an idiom; and a saint's feast is celebrated by those bearing his name.

clue.text: Ominously appear, in good year, to become depressed

indicators.note: the phrase for appearing ominously is placed inside the letters for good and year

parts.note: to loom is to appear in a threatening way

explanation.surface: Something looms over a good year and sours the mood.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling low and dejected is being dark-spirited and despondent.

clue.text: Good early composer, the source of much that is precious

definitions.text: the source of much that is precious

parts.note: early can mean old, as in early times
John Field was an Irish composer who invented the nocturne

explanation.surface: A fine old composer is praised as the fount of precious music.
explanation.definitionFit: A mining region with gold deposits yields a precious metal.

clue.text: Bound to excel

parts.note: to beat a rival at leaping, reading bound as a leap rather than certain

explanation.definitionFit: To leap higher or farther than a rival is to surpass them at springing.

clue.text: Characters in trams, ie conductors

indicators.note: the letters found in the words are used as characters for a new word

explanation.surface: Bus and tram staff are called conductors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Characters in' rearranges the letters of TRAMS and IE.
explanation.definitionFit: Distinguished orchestra leaders are honoured with this Italian title.

clue.text: A sandwich? Hardly!

parts.note: a mere sandwich is a snack, nothing like a full, proper, nourishing dinner

explanation.definitionFit: A substantial, balanced meal is the opposite of a quick snack between slices of bread.

clue.text: Box, for example, that's made of wood

definitions.text: Box, for example, that's made of wood

parts.words: Box, for example, that's made of wood
parts.note: box is an evergreen shrub that grows woody stems, so an example of a woody plant

explanation.walkthrough: 'Box' suggests a wooden crate, but it is the hedging plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Box is a species of evergreen woody plant, and such plants consist of timber.

clue.text: But for friend, I'd get involved in illicit pleasure

indicators.note: the words are tangled up together, signalling their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone excuses a guilty affair: it was all for a friend's sake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get involved' rearranges the fourteen letters of BUT FOR FRIEND I'D.
explanation.definitionFit: The apple of Eden is the proverbial emblem of a tempting pleasure that is prohibited.

clue.text: Supply the flower-girl outside

indicators.note: the girl's name goes round the outside of the word 'the'

parts.note: Lily is a girl's name that is also a flower
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone asks for the girl selling flowers to bring supplies outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Supply' looks like a verb but is the adverb from supple, read 'supple-y'.
explanation.definitionFit: Moving in a supple way is moving with flexible, graceful ease.

clue.text: One can take far too much interest in his business

definitions.text: One can take far too much interest in his business

parts.words: One can take far too much interest in his business
parts.note: a nosy person meddles, but here the interest is extortionate charges on borrowed money

explanation.definitionFit: A predatory moneylender charges exorbitant rates on borrowed cash.

clue.text: Work out how to maintain attack

parts.note: to keep something is to maintain it
a fit is an attack, as of coughing

explanation.surface: A military puzzle: figure out how to sustain an offensive.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing exercise to stay in shape is the activity of working out at a gym.

clue.text: Female teenager contrived to become independent operator

indicators.note: contrived means artificially arranged, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A girl in her teens schemes her way to independence.
explanation.definitionFit: A player or worker not bound by contract is at liberty to sign with anyone.

clue.text: Himalayan creature less deadly when beheaded?

definitions.text: Himalayan creature less deadly when beheaded?

parts.words: Himalayan creature less deadly when beheaded?
parts.note: the female animal, losing its first letter, becomes the male, and Kipling wrote the female is more deadly than the male

explanation.walkthrough: Kipling's line 'the female of the species is more deadly than the male' is the joke: removing the S turns a female bear into a male one.
explanation.definitionFit: A female Himalayan bear is a mountain mammal of that region, named by sex.

clue.text: Did visit someone over the hill

explanation.definitionFit: Having gone to a place; and a faded celebrity whose best days are gone.

clue.text: British girl in foreign country

parts.note: Olivia is a girl's name

explanation.definitionFit: A landlocked South American nation is a country abroad from a British viewpoint.

clue.text: Scrap with chaps in extra time

indicators.note: the chaps are placed inside the letters for extra and time

parts.note: an odd one is a spare or extra
chaps are men

explanation.surface: A football report: a fight broke out among the players in added time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scrap' suggests a fight, but it means a leftover piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A leftover fragment of material is a remnant or bit.

clue.text: Bow, perhaps, as king enters, in sultanate

indicators.note: the combination is put inside the sultanate

parts.note: Oman is a sultanate on the Arabian peninsula

indicators.note: the king goes into the word 'as'

parts.note: taken as written
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: Courtiers bow as the king arrives in a Gulf state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bow' suggests bending, but it is the rower nearest the front of a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: The rower seated nearest the front of a racing boat is called bow.

clue.text: Cursorily study horse I'd mounted initially

indicators.note: the reversed piece comes first, ahead of the horse
in a down clue, mounted means the letters climb upward and so read backwards

parts.note: the letters of I'd
a pinto is a piebald horse

explanation.surface: A rider studies his horse briefly once mounted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mounted' turns the I'd upward, as a down clue reads, and 'initially' places that piece ahead of the piebald horse.
explanation.definitionFit: To browse or read a little of something is to sample it superficially.

clue.text: Girl, during plague, hides here for treatment

indicators.note: the girl is set within the word for plague

parts.note: to try someone is to vex or afflict them
Anne is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl hides away for medical care during an epidemic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hides' looks like a verb but means animal skins.
explanation.definitionFit: Animal skins are turned into leather at this works.

clue.text: Former PM blunt where military exercises are involved

parts.note: Lord Salisbury was a Victorian British Prime Minister
blunt speech is plain speech

explanation.surface: A bluntly spoken ex-premier takes part in army manoeuvres.
explanation.walkthrough: SALISBURY PLAIN is a chalk plateau in Wiltshire, England, used as an army training area.
explanation.definitionFit: This Wiltshire upland is the British Army's largest training area for field manoeuvres.

clue.text: Fuel used in older vehicles

indicators.note: the answer is used within the run of letters across the words that follow

explanation.surface: A kind of fuel is said to be burned by old cars.
explanation.walkthrough: DERV is British slang for diesel fuel for road vehicles.
explanation.definitionFit: Diesel for road vehicles is a petroleum product that powers engines.

clue.text: Orchid sharing 10 in thegarden

definitions.meaning: a wild orchid bears this popular name
the first couple shared the fruit of entry 10, the apple, in Eden

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition leans on 10 across, the fruit eaten by the first man and woman in Eden.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical first couple ate the forbidden apple together, and a North American orchid carries their names.

clue.text: Discover where bad man's hiding in this country

indicators.note: the jumbled letters are concealed within the letters for this country

parts.note: UK is the abbreviation for the United Kingdom, the setter's country

indicators.note: bad suggests the letters are spoiled and so rearranged

parts.note: the letters of man's, including the S

explanation.surface: A villain lies low in Britain until someone finds him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' scrambles the letters of man's, which then sit hidden within the abbreviation for the setter's own country.
explanation.definitionFit: To expose or reveal something hidden is to uncover it.

clue.text: Not good enough to be Secretary-general, perhaps

definitions.meaning: the head of the United Nations is a UN dignitary

explanation.walkthrough: A 'worthy' is a notable person, so a United Nations Secretary-General is a 'UN worthy'.
explanation.definitionFit: Falling short of merit is being undeserving; and the UN chief is a notable figure of that body.
